info.description: The Payment Authorization API facilitates the secure authorization of payment transactions. This endpoint allows businesses to confirm and secure funds for payment requests, ensuring that payment methods are valid and available before initiating fulfillment processes. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms, subscription services, and any applications requiring efficient payment processing. By utilizing this API, developers can integrate reliable payment authorization capabilities into their systems, streamlining transaction workflows.

post.description: This endpoint processes and authorizes a payment transaction by validating the payment details and ensuring sufficient funds are available in the payer's account.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to authorize a payment. It contains the necessary information for processing the payment authorization, ensuring that all required fields are correctly filled out.

200.description: Request completed successfully and payment is authorized.

requestId.description: A unique identifier for the request.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the payment.

customer.description: Information about the customer making the payment.

resource.description: The resource related to the payment operation.

priority.description: The priority level of the payment request.

amount.description: The amount to be processed for the payment.

currency.description: The currency in which the payment is to be made.

notificationRequired.description: Indicates whether notification is required for this payment.

requestedAt.description: The timestamp when the payment was requested.

channel.description: The channel through which the payment is being made.

recordIndex.description: Index of the record in case of multiple requests.

lastName.description: The last name of the customer.
